payload.comment: Ingestion stage is consistent and complete. All split sizes (train 89996, val 10004, test 7180) match the official MedMNIST PathMNIST distribution exactly; subsampled=false confirms no truncation. n_channels=3 and n_classes=9 are correct for the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST PathMNIST task. Provenance is well-documented: archive_md5, per-split selected_index_sha256, code_sha256, and package versions are all recorded. No deterministic findings were raised. One minor reproducibility note: llm_model_digest is null (llm_model='qwen3.8' via ollama), meaning the exact model weights/checksum used for any LLM-assisted steps are not pinned. This does not affect the ingestion stage itself but should be addressed before any LLM-dependent downstream stage to ensure full run reproducibility. The test_domain_note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is an expected domain-shift annotation, not an error. No omitted artifacts. Proceed to next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null; the exact qwen3.8 model checkpoint is not pinned, which weakens reproducibility for any LLM-assisted downstream steps (non-blocking for ingestion).
